sample_unit: true/false pediatric dentistry questions (answered by 9 chatbots x 3 conversations and 60 clinicians)

links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbots versus pediatric dentists, general dentists, and students on the same questions
links.effect: Pediatric dentists 96.67%±4.3%, general dentists 88.0%±6.1%, students 80.8%±6.9%; best chatbot (ChatGPT) 78%±3%; clinicians significantly more accurate than chatbots (p<0.001).
links.quote: General dentists (88.0 % ± 6.1 %) also demonstrated significantly higher accuracy than chatbots (p < 0.001), followed by students (80.8 %±6.9 %).

links.outcome: Consistency of chatbot answers across 3 independent conversations (Cronbach's alpha)
links.effect: All chatbots except ChatGPT3.5 showed acceptable consistency (Cronbach alpha>0.7).
links.quote: All chatbots except ChatGPT3.5 showed acceptable consistency (Cronbach alpha>0.7).

screen.reason: Compares the baseline accuracy and consistency of several LLM chatbots against dentists on a set of pediatric dentistry questions without testing any deployment practices or guardrails.
